name: pyright-spike
description: Spike: pyright (browser-basedpyright) as a type checker for Source Python

scripts.build: mkdir -p build && node closure.cjs builtins typing typing_extensions _typeshed types collections.abc > build/keep.txt && node trim.cjs build/worker.nostubs.js && node trim.cjs build/worker.min.js build/keep.txt && node extract-builtins.cjs && node patch-builtins.cjs
